name: canttrust
description: Restrict Russian CA trust to Russian domains in Firefox.

scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify-policy.mjs && node scripts/scan-bundle.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.build:self-hosted: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && node scripts/build.mjs self-hosted && node scripts/verify-policy.mjs && node scripts/scan-bundle.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --self-hosted --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package:firefox: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify-policy.mjs && node scripts/scan-bundle.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename canttrust-{version}-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
